assumptions.text: Therapists are the first vertical; other verticals will reuse the same pipeline with different prompts.
assumptions.test: Build second vertical (e.g., HVAC) and measure reuse.

assumptions.text: Publicly available web data (reviews, website, social) is sufficient to populate a useful meeting kit.
assumptions.test: Run against 10 real therapist sites and measure field coverage.

assumptions.text: Founder prefers bullet-point call scripts over full prose.
Outreach CRM contact table can be extended with practice-specific JSONB without migration conflicts.
assumptions.test: Review schema and run migration preflight.

assumptions.text: Manual send for follow-up email/SMS in Phase 1 does not violate consent model.
assumptions.test: Confirm consent-gated send path can be called manually.

assumptions.text: Production tables sales_call_recordings, coaching_clips, real_time_coaching_events, and sales_technique_patterns are proven schema that can be reused for Phase 3–4 after a migration to decouple from boldtrail_agents.
assumptions.test: Compare columns in db/migrations/20260313_core_schema.sql against SalesOS Phase 3–4 needs and confirm migration path.

assumptions.text: The Human Performance Engine concept is premature to build in Phase 1 and should be deferred until Phase 3 has produced real call data and a second domain needs the same loop.
assumptions.test: Revisit after Phase 1 and Phase 3 are live and at least one other domain (e.g., therapy, brainstorming) requires the same observe→understand→support loop.

assumptions.text: Two directory sources (Psychology Today + Yelp) are sufficient to prove the discovery pipeline pattern before adding more source connectors.
assumptions.test: Run the pilot against one territory and measure how many real practices neither source surfaced, using a manual spot-check.

assumptions.text: Deterministic matching (domain, phone, address) resolves most candidate duplicates without needing a model call.
assumptions.test: Measure what fraction of the pilot's candidates required escalation to a model for ambiguous matching vs. resolved deterministically.

assumptions.text: A single Nevada territory pilot (e.g. Henderson) is representative enough to validate the discovery pipeline before expanding statewide.
assumptions.test: Compare pilot cost-per-verified-record and coverage against a second, different territory before committing to full expansion.
